enabled.title: Enable Clip Courier
enabled.description: Allows the reviewed !clip command and any optional current-stream discovery to send confirmed clips to Discord.

automaticCurrentStreamClips.title: Also send other clips made during this stream
automaticCurrentStreamClips.description: Optional. Uses Twitch creation timestamps and the observed Twitch online/offline session. Clips from earlier streams never qualify.

destinationMode.title: Discord destination
destinationMode.description: Choose the channel type that owns the private webhook. One webhook cannot safely target both types.

maximumHistory.title: Maximum delivered clip IDs remembered
maximumHistory.description: Prevents repeat Discord posts while keeping private state bounded.

webhookName.title: Discord webhook display name
webhookName.description: The sender name Discord displays for Clip Courier posts.

forumTagIds.title: Optional Discord forum tag IDs
forumTagIds.description: One numeric tag ID per line, up to five.
